svg.title: Locomotion during the sensorimotor mismatch block
svg.desc: Per session, the block mean forward speed, the number of mismatch trials in which the animal was running at each threshold, and the number of trials surviving in the worst event type, which limits any per-event analysis.
svg.text: Locomotion during the sensorimotor mismatch block
Optic flow is generated by locomotion, so a stationary animal has no flow to decouple and the mismatch is not a stimulus
A trial qualifies when mean forward speed reaches the threshold in both the 343 ms pre-event window and the mismatch window
Median session speed 1.56 cm/s; 23 of 39 sessions have a median of 0.00 cm/s; 11 sessions clear the minimum in all four event types at 5 cm/s
of 35 each, at the 5 cm/s gate
Panel B: darker is more qualifying trials
